title: Wire EDM Production AI — Operator, Documentation, Safety, Integration

units.title: Operator/training AI domains
units.details: Added 4 operator domains: wedm_operator_guidance (skill-calibrated tips), wedm_skill_assessment (competency evaluation), wedm_training_recommendation (learning paths), wedm_real_time_assist (alarm/status guidance)

units.title: Documentation AI domains
units.details: Added 4 documentation domains: wedm_setup_documentation (setup sheets), wedm_work_instruction (ISO-compliant WIs), wedm_process_sheet (routing docs), wedm_knowledge_capture (lessons learned)

units.title: Safety/compliance AI domains
units.details: Added 4 safety domains: wedm_safety_analysis (hazard ID), wedm_hazard_prevention (mitigation), wedm_compliance_check (AS9100/ISO13485/ITAR), wedm_environmental (waste/disposal)

units.title: Integration/simulation AI domains
units.details: Added 4 integration domains: wedm_erp_integration (job tracking), wedm_mes_integration (cell coordination), wedm_simulation_verify (path validation), wedm_dnc_optimization (transfer efficiency)

units.title: Tribal synthesis for production domains
units.details: Added all 16 production domains to manufacturingDomains array for tribal knowledge injection

units.title: WEDMCompleteOrchestrationEngine production AI integration
units.details: Extended collectAIRecommendations() with 16 new domain calls (operator, documentation, safety, integration). Added operator_skill_level and job_number input fields. Extended ai_recommendations interface with 16 new fields. Enhanced synthesis report with operator, setup doc, safety, compliance, ERP, simulation summaries.

units.title: Production AI test suite
units.details: 29 tests covering: operator/training domains (4), documentation domains (4), safety/compliance domains (4), integration/simulation domains (4), orchestration integration (6), synthesis report (1), tribal synthesis (3), medical compliance (1), defense compliance (1), skill calibration (1)

documentation: wedm_setup_documentation — machine setup sheets, tool lists

integration_points.WEDMCompleteOrchestrationEngine: Conditional AI for compliance (aerospace/medical/defense), full production domain coverage

summary: Production AI hardening for Wire EDM operations. 16 new domains covering: operator/training (guidance, assessment, training, real-time assist), documentation (setup, work instructions, process sheets, knowledge capture), safety/compliance (analysis, prevention, compliance check, environmental), and integration/simulation (ERP, MES, simulation, DNC). All domains integrated into pipeline with conditional compliance activation for aerospace/medical/defense. 29 tests + prior 110 = 139 total WEDM AI tests.
